objective: Transfer six bounded video-game mechanisms into current FIELD hosts without importing their fiction, branded skin, economies, score logic or authority models.

transfers.rule: failed attempts must change the next encounter or stop
useful residue may aid later actors without synchronous shared state
predictable effects should be visible before authoritative commit
support may succeed by removing itself after capability transfer

authority: No donor grants FIELD new mutation authority. RUMOR is a read-only projection over existing route-owned declarations and resolves the original manifest route.

verification.repo: CURRENT↔manifest drift + route registration + public surface + gitleaks

falsifier: Delete RUMOR if it behaves like a quest/backlog, manufactures urgency, or duplicates existing route reading without reducing re-entry friction.
next: Do not add another game-derived UI until a current FIELD friction names a missing function.
